notes.content: The Business Administration B.S. provides preparation for careers in a wide range of business administration and business-related fields, along with: a broad, liberal education, a basic understanding of the operation of a business enterprise, an understanding of the environment in which business exists and of which it is a part, proficiency in analyzing, evaluating, and synthesizing managerial decisions, and a degree of specialized training in a selected area. The Business Administration core is a closely coordinated sequence of courses which introduces students to the broad ﬁeld of business administration, develops knowledge of the organizational and management concepts which underlie the operation of all business enterprises, and develops effective ways of thinking about complex situations encountered in business administration. Except for the integrating course in business policy, which must be taken as the last course in the business administration core, students should schedule most courses in the core in their junior year. View information for the College of Business Administration .
notes.contentHtml:
The Business Administration B.S. provides preparation for careers in a wide range of business administration and business-related fields, along with:

  • a broad, liberal education,
  • a basic understanding of the operation of a business enterprise,
  • an understanding of the environment in which business exists and of which it is a part,
  • proficiency in analyzing, evaluating, and synthesizing managerial decisions, and
  • a degree of specialized training in a selected area.


The Business Administration core is a closely coordinated sequence of courses which introduces students to the broad ﬁeld of business administration, develops knowledge of the organizational and management concepts which underlie the operation of all business enterprises, and develops effective ways of thinking about complex situations encountered in business administration. Except for the integrating course in business policy, which must be taken as the last course in the business administration core, students should schedule most courses in the core in their junior year.


View information for the College of Business Administration.

notes.content: NOTE : Students planning to receive a degree in business administration should emphasize general education during the first two years, thus laying a foundation upon which the program can be built. In addition, the specified prerequisites to the degree should be completed. Most courses within the College of Business Administration have specific subject matter prerequisites that must be completed to qualify for enrollment. Lacking such prerequisites, students who can offer convincing evidence of having acquired the necessary background by other means may petition the professor in charge of the course for permission to enroll. At the discretion of the College, a qualifying examination may be required.

notes.content: The area of concentration provides the opportunity for specialized study in a selected area of interest. Available concentrations include: Accounting Computer Information Systems Finance General Business Management (with Tracks in Human Resources, International Business, and Entrepreneurship) Marketing Operations Management
notes.contentHtml:
The area of concentration provides the opportunity for specialized study in a selected area of interest. Available concentrations include:

  • Accounting
  • Computer Information Systems
  • Finance
  • General Business
  • Management (with Tracks in Human Resources, International Business, and Entrepreneurship)
  • Marketing
  • Operations Management

notes.content: Accounting The Accounting concentration must be completed with an overall grade point average of 2.0 or better. Computer Information Systems The Computer Information Systems concentration requires additional lower-division courses (see below). Finance The Finance concentration must be completed with an overall grade point average of 2.0 or better. General Business All courses in the General Business concentration must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better. Management All courses in the Management concentration must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better. Marketing All courses in the Marketing concentration including the business administration prerequisites and core must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better. Operations Management All courses in the Operations Management concentration, including the Business Administration prerequisites and core, must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better.
notes.contentHtml:
Accounting

The Accounting concentration must be completed with an overall grade point average of 2.0 or better.


Computer Information Systems

The Computer Information Systems concentration requires additional lower-division courses (see below).


Finance

The Finance concentration must be completed with an overall grade point average of 2.0 or better.


General Business

All courses in the General Business concentration must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better.


Management

All courses in the Management concentration must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better.


Marketing

All courses in the Marketing concentration including the business administration prerequisites and core must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better.


Operations Management

All courses in the Operations Management concentration, including the Business Administration prerequisites and core, must be completed with a letter grade of C– or better.
